status: Compositor/UI: 41 of 41 files have real functional coverage (32 unmodified symlinks, 8 via the overrides above, 1 excluded as dead code). Two real compiler-architecture bugs were found and fixed along the way, both general improvements to Sources/Compat/SwiftUI, not per-file patches: ModifiedContent was generic over its wrapped content, so every modifier in a chain nested a new type layer, which is what made Swift's constraint solver time out on long chains generally (erased it to `any View` internally); and a genuine .onDrop overload ambiguity. ContentView.swift needed one further, user-authorized exception: it's the only file in Compositor/UI not compiled from an unmodified symlink — Sources/Overrides/ContentView.swift is a byte-for-byte copy with exactly one structural change (splitting `body`, the same type-checker-driven split upstream's own authors already applied twice in this file) plus a minimal CompositorApplicationDelegate stand-in (three plain members only; the real NSObject/NSApplicationDelegate/Sparkle-based class stays excluded, Qt owns that role). See docs/platform-abstraction.md and the SwiftUI-compat-runtime plan for the generic Sources/Compat/SwiftUI runtime this replaced the old blanket 'Compositor/UI: Qt workflow adapter' entry with.
